item.title: South Australia locks in $2 billion hospital funding boost from the Commonwealth
item.description: South Australia has secured an extra $2 billion in federal funding for public hospitals, lifting total Commonwealth support to $15.2 billion and backing major hospital and workforce expansion across the state.

item.title: FRINGE: Little Boxes is the hilarious, touching show inspired by Boy George, motherhood and refusing limits
item.description: Written off early and underestimated for years, Joann Condon’s award-winning Fringe show Little Boxes is a funny, moving invitation to knock down the labels holding us back.

item.description: Experience the festival that brings hundreds of exotic and rare cars from far and wide in absolute style from the comfort of this luxe suite brought to you by BMW M.

item.title: Three new kitchen gadgets are setting South Aussie summer cooking trends
item.description: These three new kitchen essentials are defining how South Australians are cooking and entertaining this summer.

item.title: Kies Family Wines is turning Gather Round into the ultimate celebration with a three day winery footy festival
item.description: As AFL Gather Round returns this April, Kies Family Wines is welcoming fans to Lyndoch for a three-day Barossa-hosted celebration of wine, food, live music and footy just steps from Barossa Park.

item.description: After a hot Saturday, Adelaide cools down with southerly winds, sunny skies and a settled week ahead.

item.title: South Australia secures $801.5 million deal to build thousands of new homes for first-time buyers
item.description: South Australia has secured a landmark $801.5 million funding deal to deliver nearly 7,000 new homes for first homebuyers, accelerating housing developments across the state.
